request.prompt:
Goods: Running shoes, rubber outer soles, textile uppers
Country of origin: VN

Choose the chapter that covers these goods. Options:
- 64: Footwear; gaiters and the like; parts of such articles
    contains 640411: Sports footwear; tennis shoes, basketball shoes, gym shoes, training shoes and the like, with outer soles of rubber or plastics and uppers of textile materials
    contains 640419: Footwear; (other than sportswear), with outer soles of rubber or plastics and uppers of textile materials
    contains 640220: Footwear; with outer soles and uppers of rubber or plastics, upper straps or thongs assembled to the sole by plugs
    contains 640219: Sports footwear; (other than ski-boots, snowboard boots or cross-country ski footwear), with outer soles and uppers of rubber or plastics
    contains 640420: Footwear; outer soles of leather or composition leather, uppers of textile materials
    contains 640299: Footwear; n.e.c. in heading no. 6402, (other than just covering the ankle), with outer soles and uppers of rubber or plastics
    contains 640199: Footwear; waterproof, n.e.c. in heading no. 6401, rubber or plastic outer soles and uppers (not assembled by stitch, rivet, nail, screw, plug or similar)
    contains 640212: Sports footwear; with outer soles and uppers of rubber or plastics, ski-boots, cross-country ski footwear and snowboard boots
    contains 640110: Footwear; waterproof with metal toe-cap, rubber or plastic outer soles and uppers (not assembled by stitch, rivet, nail, screw, plug or similar)
    contains 640319: Sports footwear; (other than ski-boots, snowboard boots or cross-country ski footwear), with outer soles of rubber, plastics, leather or composition leather and uppers of leather
    contains 640192: Footwear; waterproof, covering the ankle (but not the knee), rubber or plastic outer soles and uppers (not assembled by stitch, rivet, nail, screw, plug or similar)
    contains 640291: Footwear; n.e.c. in heading no. 6402, covering the ankle, with outer soles and uppers of rubber or plastics
    contains 640312: Sports footwear; with outer soles of rubber, plastics, leather or composition leather and uppers of leather, ski-boots, snowboard boots and cross-country ski footwear
    contains 640399: Footwear; n.e.c. in heading no. 6403, (not covering the ankle), outer soles of rubber, plastics or composition leather, uppers of leather
    contains 640391: Footwear; n.e.c. in heading no. 6403, covering the ankle, outer soles of rubber, plastics or composition leather, uppers of leather
    contains 640340: Footwear; with metal toe-cap, outer soles of rubber, plastics, leather or composition leather, uppers of leather
    contains 640359: Footwear; n.e.c. in heading no. 6403, (not covering the ankle), outer soles and uppers of leather
    contains 640320: Footwear; with outer soles of leather, uppers consisting of leather straps across instep and around the big toe
    contains 640351: Footwear; n.e.c. in heading no. 6403, with outer soles and uppers of leather, covering the ankle
- 40: Rubber and articles thereof
    contains 400932: Rubber; vulcanised (other than hard rubber), tubing, piping and hoses, reinforced or otherwise combined only with textile materials, with fittings

Answer "none" if no option can cover these goods.

data.reason: Running shoes with rubber outer soles and textile uppers are sports footwear covered by Chapter 64 (subheading 640411), not Chapter 40, which covers rubber and articles thereof.
